avatar.bio:
I am a creative strategist with a background in financial and analytical disciplines, currently focused on brand development, content creation, and digital experimentation. My work sits at the intersection of structure and creativity, where I combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

I approach marketing as a system rather than a set of isolated actions. My focus is on building coherent brand ecosystems—aligning message, visuals, and content to create consistency and long-term impact. I am involved across the full process, from concept development and planning to production and final delivery.

Through my experiences in hospitality, creative projects, and AI-driven environments, I have developed a practical understanding of how ideas translate into real outputs. I am particularly interested in improving creative workflows, building small tools, and exploring how AI can support more efficient and scalable production.

I work best in collaborative environments where ideas can be challenged and refined. I value clarity, consistency, and attention to detail, while maintaining a pragmatic approach to execution.
